create_async_connection: create an AsyncConnection to a dm_env_rpc server using an existing gRPC async channel
send_request_to_server: send a dm_env_rpc Request message to the server and await the corresponding Response
close_async_connection: close the AsyncConnection stream when the dm_env_rpc server connection is no longer needed
use_async_connection_context_manager: use AsyncConnection as a context manager to automatically close the connection on exit
create_secure_channel_and_connect: create a secure async gRPC channel and connect to a dm_env_rpc server in one call
